## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / integration / E2E as relevant), and `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (docs site, README, ADR for decisions) or not needed
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing package/app changes, or not needed
- [ ] UI strings translated through next-intl (`en` and `it`), `pnpm i18n:check` passes
- [ ] Accessibility checked for UI changes (keyboard, labels, contrast)
- [ ] Tax changes cite their legal source and update golden fixtures (or not applicable)
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/))
